title: Playtime Moments with Mum
desc: Playtime became your favorite part of the day, especially when Mum was involved. Even when she wasn't talking to you, you were completely convinced that she was, and you had plenty to say back.
story: It became a running joke in the house that Mum could not even eat a meal in peace anymore. There she would be, fork halfway to her mouth, quietly chewing, and you would lock eyes with her from across the room and just launch into conversation, kicking your legs, waving your arms, babbling away with the most urgent expression on your face. She would laugh, which only encouraged you further, your whole body wiggling with excitement like you had been waiting all day for this exact moment. It did not matter that she was mid-bite or mid-sentence with someone else, in your eyes, everything Mum did was meant entirely for you, and honestly, she didn't mind one bit.
